_rules: Every feature starts failing. Status changes ONLY via scripts/verify_feature.py after tests run.

features.title: Project setup, settings file, test markers, dependency record
acceptance: uv sync --locked succeeds; runtime deps pinned with ==
agent-desk --help runs and lists simulate, run, approve, eval
settings load defaults from agent-desk.example.toml; AGENT_DESK_REFUND_LIMIT overrides the limit
kafka and live markers registered; default run deselects them; socket guard blocks non-loopback connects
no keys or user paths in src, tests, lessons; every pyproject dependency is listed in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md

features.title: Message schemas, Bus interface, MemoryBus
acceptance: envelope and payload models round-trip to JSON; bad input raises BadMessage naming the field
same key is read in publish order
two consumers in one group share messages; two groups each get all
uncommitted message is redelivered; committed message is not

features.title: Consumer runner: idempotency, retries with backoff, dead letter, replay
acceptance: same message handled twice runs the handler once; handled store survives a restart (file-backed)
handler failing twice then succeeding is called three times; delays follow base*2^(n-1) plus bounded jitter with an injected clock
BadMessage goes to desk.dead-letter at once; transient failure goes after max_attempts; dlq headers set
consumer handles the next message after a dead letter; replay republishes to the source topic

features.title: Seeded shop DB and FastMCP shop server
acceptance: seed builds the SQLite DB from fixed data; running it twice gives the same rows
lookup_order, shipment_status, refund_policy return seeded data for known ids
unknown id returns an isError result naming the id; no exception leaves the server
issue_refund with the same idempotency key refunds once

features.title: LLM client on LiteLLM, ScriptedModel, triage agent
acceptance: chat() passes model string, api_base and timeout to a patched litellm.completion
missing provider key error names the env var, never a value; connection, timeout and 4xx map to ModelDown, ModelTimeout, ModelError
triage with the scripted model publishes category and priority to desk.work
invalid model output gets one repair prompt, then raises; triage is idempotent
features.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_model.py tests/test_fakes.py tests/test_triage.py

features.title: Resolver LangGraph graph with SQLite checkpointer and MCP tools
acceptance: status ticket reaches reply with no approval; refund at or below the limit goes decide, act, reply
step limit (default 8 model calls) stops the graph with a clear message
graph stopped after gather and rebuilt from the same checkpoint file does not repeat gather
resolver publishes exactly one result per idempotency key to desk.results

features.title: Human approval flow: interrupt, decisions topic, CLI and web approver
acceptance: refund above the limit publishes approval.requested and the graph stops; other tickets keep flowing
approve issues the refund once; reject declines with the reviewer note; duplicate decision does nothing
resolver restarted between request and decision still resumes
CLI approve publishes a decision; web approver lists and posts decisions and binds to 127.0.0.1 only

features.title: Structured logs and OpenTelemetry traces across hops
acceptance: every log line for a ticket has ts, level, component, ticket_id, message_id, trace_id, attempt, event
no log line contains an API key value
spans of one ticket (simulate, triage, resolve, approve) share one trace id through message headers
spans carry ticket_id and topic attributes; OTLP export is off by default

features.title: Ticket simulator, CLI wiring, triage eval
acceptance: data/tickets.jsonl holds at least 40 labeled tickets; same seed gives same order
--poison N adds malformed messages; --duplicate N re-sends ids
eval triage with a copying script gives accuracy 1.0; with one wrong gives (n-1)/n and a confusion cell
eval writes runs/eval-<time>.json with model name and set size; results command prints a table
features.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_simulator.py tests/test_evals.py tests/test_cli.py

features.title: Native Kafka on Windows (KRaft, PowerShell script), KafkaBus, topics, opt-in Kafka tests
acceptance: broker config template has KRaft settings, no ZooKeeper, loopback listener, high retention; kafka-local.ps1 exists; README commands name existing files and state the Windows and EC2 fallback caveats (offline test)
KafkaBus commits the offset only after the handler returns (offline test with a fake client)
kafka-marked tests (opt-in, need AGENT_DESK_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP): publish and consume round-trip with headers; topics create is repeatable; failed handler is redelivered
pytest -m kafka without the env var skips with a reason; with it but no broker, fails fast with one clear message

features.title: Lessons 01-06, README, comment check
acceptance: each lesson script runs offline with --fake and exits 0
each lesson names the concept, command, expected output and files to read
every src module has a docstring and every public function has a docstring
docs and lessons say exactly-once only in a sentence that denies the claim
